description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller for managing tax configuration in the admin interface of a web application. It provides endpoints for displaying and saving tax settings, interacts with a TaxService, and handles menu setup.

classes.name: TaxConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for tax configuration settings in the admin panel, handling display and save operations.

methods.name: displayTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current tax configuration, initializing if absent.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated tax configuration settings.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the administrative menu context for the view.
